consumer: The GUI monster HP-bar renderer that asks what bar segments and what color (green/yellow/red) to display for a visible monster.
scope: The displayed, GUI-formatted HP-bar color/segment view for a single visible monster, as the GUI would quantize it.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (monsters) — emits raw mon.get_hp()/get_hp_max() integers straight from the engine getters, i.e. simulation-state ground truth, not the GUI's color computation.
divergence: A monster whose hp/hp_max ratio lands on a color-bucket boundary: the GUI's quantized bar shows one color (e.g. yellow) while a frontend re-deriving green/yellow/red from the raw integers picks a different color/segment than the GUI's own bucketing.
